title: Proofread
description: English the reader wrote, corrected. Each fix names the words it replaces so the editor can underline them in place, and says why in Hindi — a correction a learner cannot read teaches nothing.

corrected.description: The whole text with every fix applied, and nothing else changed.

fixes.description: One per mistake, in the order they appear.

wrong.description: The words as the reader wrote them, copied exactly so they can be found in the text.

kind.description: spelling is a misspelt word, grammar is a rule, wording is understandable but not what a fluent writer would put.

why.description: The reason, in Hindi, in a line.
